name: e2-simplicial-mld-3
question: For each simplicial toric 3-fold germ C^3/G, with G = N/Z^3 abelian of order r <= 1200 and the rays primitive, what are the mld, the terminal and canonical germs and the enc germs, is every terminal germ cyclic of type 1/r(1, -1, a), and do the isolated cyclic germs agree with the run e2-cyclic-quotient-mld-3 to index 40?
result: agrees: in 110004193 simplicial toric 3-fold germs with r <= 1200, each terminal germ is cyclic of type 1/r(1, -1, a) with the mld 1 + 1/r, and the cyclic isolated germs with r <= 40 are those of the family cyclic
